$comment: impeccable detector ignores. Checked in so every run of `npx impeccable detect` agrees. Run WITHOUT --no-config to honour this file. Reasons live in $reasons below.

$reasons.nested-cards: A widget (.widget) is a bordered panel holding controls, plots and readouts. Its children (.w-ctl, .seg, .w-out, .calc-readout) are control surfaces inside that panel, not decorative cards stacked on cards. Flattening them would strip 36 interactive widgets of their visual grouping. The page already separates regions with whitespace, rules and background steps (--bg-0/1/2/3) instead of nested boxes.
$reasons.oversized-h1: The hero h1 is clamp(40px, 5vw, 56px) - a deliberate editorial display size for one title line. The reported '184px' is the h1 box width, not a font-size; no font-size above 56px exists in the stylesheet. Verified: the only font-size literal in index.html is 12px, and css/styles.css alone scans clean.
$reasons.dark-glow: All coloured box-shadow halos were removed (rgba(184,52,31,...) glows, rgba(58,40,20,...) warm drop shadows, drop-shadow filters). What remains is a flat 1px zero-blur ring on .telemetry-beacon - a selection affordance, not a glow.
$reasons.flat-type-hierarchy: The detector reports body/h1/h2/h3 all at 16px, which does not match the stylesheet: body 18px, h1 clamp(40px,5vw,56px), h2 clamp(30px,3.8vw,41px), h3 26px, h4 12px. It cannot resolve clamp() and falls back to the 16px initial value.
$reasons.cramped-padding: 3 residual hits, all on .spec-cell in the hero spec band. The cells already carry padding:var(--s-4) var(--s-5) var(--s-4) 10px, and the stacked breakpoints inset below the divider. Bisected against an isolated 2-cell fixture: the rule does not fire at 0/6/10/16px left padding, so it is not measuring the padding value - it fires on the presence of the divider itself. Left as-is rather than restyling a working spec band to satisfy a heuristic. Re-check with: npx impeccable detect index.html css js _parts
